name: io.github.intelation-labs/nexis-mcp
title: Intelation Nexis
description: Find and remove personal data (PII) from text. Regulation-aware: GDPR, UK GDPR, HIPAA.

environmentVariables.name: NEXIS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Nexis API key. Get a free one at https://nexis.intelation.com

environmentVariables.name: NEXIS_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: Default regulation|country|sub-region|language. Otherwise the first country in your plan

environmentVariables.name: NEXIS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Fernet key for the encryption method and decrypt_text

environmentVariables.name: NEXIS_ALLOW_DECRYPT
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to turn on decrypt_text. The assistant then sees the original personal data

environmentVariables.name: NEXIS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Only for a dedicated or on-premises Nexis instance
